examples.knowledge_point: Multiplying a 2x2 Matrix by a Column Vector
examples.worked_solution:
We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product. Multiplying the first row, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 7 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 \\ 5\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1\cdot 2+3\cdot 5 \\ ∗\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}17 \\ ∗\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Multiplying the second row, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 7 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 \\ 5\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}17 \\ 7\cdot 2+(-2)\cdot 5\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}17 \\ 4\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
